hooks.command: [ -z "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" ] || ! cmp -s "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"/.claude/settings.json "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/.claude/settings.json || exit 0; m=$(jq -er 'select(.agent_type // "" | endswith("critic")) | .tool_input.message // ""') || exit 0; printf %s "$m" | "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}"/.agent/scripts/verdict || exit 2
